name: An Zinmei
source:
The Magician of May / The Dimension Magician

Enmei's younger sister and co-Magician. Despite being a Magician, she's unable to use her true ability. Innocent and a bit slow on the uptake, she's often left behind by Enmei who takes on most of their work by himself.

Although she hasn't been able to live up to Enmei's expectations, he's never called her an insulting name or looked down on her. Zinmei greatly appreciates this, but is torn by a feeling of disappointing him. Because of Enmei's unspoken kindness, Zinmei is loyal to him and rarely questions his decisions until meeting Parilyne.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/832427.an-zinmei]official bio[/url]]
